introHtml: Snugz shot glasses combine durable glass or plastic construction with a comfortable, easy-grip design that your customers will appreciate. Whether you choose clear glass for a classic look or plastic for outdoor events, these shot glasses offer smooth sides ideal for screen printing or full-color digital decoration. Perfect for bar promotions, tailgates, or corporate giveaways, Snugz shot glasses deliver a premium feel without the premium price.
